name: cost-ledger
description: Cost ledger across all chats: after every answer it records the chat cost (as /cost), tokens per model and model calls made by other mods. /ledger shows totals for today, 7 and 30 days and all time (chats incl. their mod calls), the last 14 days, projects and the most expensive chats; /ledger here shows what this project and this chat cost, with the chat share as a ring; /ledger limits shows the API value in the current 5-hour and weekly window and in your subscription month, plus an estimate of the usage outside the ledger (claude.ai, phone); /ledger sync <folder> merges your devices through a shared folder (amounts and the project folder name only: no paths or chat titles); /ledger help lists all commands, the current state and your settings. Observer only, no model calls.

language.title: Language / Sprache
language.description: Language of the mod's texts. en: English, de: Deutsch.

keepDays.title: Retention (days)
keepDays.description: Chats that have not been recorded for this many days are deleted by cost-ledger at the next /ledger.

dayYellow.title: Daily amount yellow from ($)
dayYellow.description: From this daily amount (chat + mods), the amount in the daily history turns yellow.

dayRed.title: Daily amount red from ($)
dayRed.description: From this daily amount (chat + mods), the amount in the daily history turns red.
